defs.def: to become aware of sb/sth by using your eyes 看见；看到（不用于进行时）

ex.s: Kevin wanted to see the dictionary.
ex.t: 凯文想看看那本词典。

ex.s: Even if they don’t eat it, they’ re seeing it.
ex.t: 即使他们不吃，他们也能看到它。

ex.s: Or will they see the big word “fail” in red?
ex.t: 或者他们会看到那个红色的大字“失败”？

ex.s: The path offers over 300 plant species for visitors to see, too.
ex.t: 这条小径沿途还有300多种植物供游客观赏。

ex.s: A feeling of helplessness washed over me as I saw the bus queue thinning out.
ex.t: 当我看到排队等巴士的人越来越少，一种无助感涌上心头。

ex.s: A feeling of helplessness washed over me as I saw the bus queue thinning out.
ex.t: 当我看到排队等巴士的人越来越少，一种无助感涌上心头。

ex.s: One day, I saw a boy walking along George Street with an armful of books.
ex.t: 有一天，我看见一个男孩抱着一摞书沿乔治街走着。

ex.s: In April last year, I saw a post on the PNP (Pilots N Paws) website from a family in Topeka.
ex.t: 去年四月，我在PNP（飞行员与爪子）网站上看到托皮卡一个家庭的帖子。

ex.s: Then I saw a group of people in bathing suits bouncing up and down in the water.
ex.t: 然后我看见一群穿着泳衣的人在水里上下蹦跳。

ex.s: How did the author feel upon seeing the email sender’s name?
ex.t: 看到邮件发件人的名字时，作者是什么感受？

ex.s: Picture this: my grandson sitting on my lap as I hold the book in front so he can see the pictures.
ex.t: 想象一下：我的孙子坐在我腿上，我把书举在他面前让他看到图片。

ex.s: He pushed a chair onto the balcony, and climbed up   59   （see）them.
ex.t: 他把一把椅子推到阳台上，爬上去（第59空，see）他们。

ex.s: He looked up and saw Eric hanging from the balcony.
ex.t: 他抬头一看，看到Eric挂在阳台上。

ex.s: She has chances to see rare animals.
ex.t: 她有机会看到稀有动物。

ex.s: I had never seen so many people wanting food.
ex.t: 我从未见过这么多人想要食物。

ex.s: “I've seen those magic moments when children are talking to someone they are inspired by - their eyes are shining and their faces light up,” she said.
ex.t: “我曾见过那些神奇的时刻，当孩子们与激励他们的人交谈时——他们的眼睛闪闪发亮，脸上焕发光彩，”她说。

ex.s: One day, I saw a commercial for a health-care company.
ex.t: 一天，我看到一家医疗保健公司的广告。

ex.s: Seeing the world is a must for children.
ex.t: 看世界对孩子是必要的。

ex.s: In a wired world with constant global communication, we're all positioned to see flashes of genius wherever they appear.
ex.t: 在一个有线连接、全球沟通不断的世界里，我们都有机会看到天才的闪光，无论出现在哪里。

ex.s: Currently, about 35,000 works                   in over 300 rooms in the Louvre, and it would take a lifetime to see everything.
ex.t: 目前，约35,000件作品___在卢浮宫300多个展厅中，要看遍所有东西得花上一辈子。

ex.s: I see our lizard, raw and nearly new.
ex.t: 我看到我们的蜥蜴崭新而近乎重生。

ex.s: Campers will share their colorful ideas and imagination with each other and work together to visualize, sketch and paint with non-traditional techniques to create the coolest mural which will be displayed in public for all to see.
ex.t: 营员们将彼此分享他们多彩的想法和想象力，并合作通过可视化、素描和非传统技法进行创作，画出最酷的壁画，这幅壁画将在公共场合展出供所有人观看。

ex.s: What can visitors see in both Classical Provence and Southern Spain？
ex.t: 游客在古典普罗旺斯和西班牙南部都能看到什么？

ex.s: To see famous film stars.
ex.t: 见著名电影明星。

ex.s: All speakers were confident, comfortable with being seen.
ex.t: 后来有一天，我在一个大型会议上，突然像闪电一样受到了启发。

ex.s: As we exited from the parking garage, we could see the fountain as we walked down the long staircase.
ex.t: 我看到那里有个黑色的东西，但它就在一位站在喷泉旁的女士旁边，所以我无法看清那是什么或是否是她的。

ex.s: I saw something black   22   there, but it was right next to a woman standing by the fountain, so I could not   23   what it was or if it was hers.
ex.t: 我看到那里有件黑色的东西___22___，但它就站在喷泉旁一位女士脚边，所以我无法___23___那是什么，或是不是她的。

ex.s: "See it, Dad?" Ponder shouted.
ex.t: "看到了吗，爸爸？"Ponder喊道。

ex.s: Ehlers   41   about the small dog he had seen   42   alongside the road.
ex.t: 埃勒斯____41____他在路边____42____看到的那只小狗。

ex.s: Greg saw, across a field, the dog moving   48   away.
ex.t: 格雷格看到，那只狗穿过田野，___48___离开。

ex.s: I saw there were two instructors on board and a man lying across the middle.
ex.t: 我看到船上有两名教练，还有一个男人横躺在中间。

ex.s: I was impressed to see my dad and Uncle Paul riding horses.
ex.t: 看到爸爸和保罗叔叔骑马，给我留下了深刻的印象。

ex.s: How many kinds of wildflowers can be seen from your front door If your awareness is as sharp as it could be, you'll have no trouble answering these questions．
ex.t: 从你家门前能看到多少种野花？如果你的感知力达到最强，你就能毫不费力地回答这些问题。

ex.s: Relearning the art of seeing the world around us is quite simple, although it takes practice and requires breaking some bad habits．
ex.t: 重新学习观察周围世界的艺术其实很简单，尽管需要练习，还需要改掉一些坏习惯。

ex.s: The first step in awakening senses is to stop predicting what we are going to see and feel before it occurs.
ex.t: 唤醒感官的第一步是在事情发生之前停止预测我们将要看到和感觉到什么。

ex.s: They are keen to see rare birds at the destination．
ex.t: D．他们渴望在目的地看到稀有鸟类。

ex.s: As I approached mile 23, I could see my wife waving a sign.
ex.t: 接近23英里时，我看见妻子挥舞着牌子。

ex.s: What I saw was completely unlike anything I had experienced in the   50   .
ex.t: 我所看到的完全不同于我在____中经历过的任何事物。

ex.s: These were the first pictures and first real paint and brushes Benjamin had  ever  seen.
ex.t: 这些是本杰明见过的第一批照片 和第一批真正的油漆和刷子

ex.s: He saw a steep uphill climb before him.
ex.t: 他看到前方有一段陡峭的上坡路。

ex.s: This small group bike tour is a fantastic way to see a world-famous cherry trees with beautiful flowers of Washington, D.C.
ex.t: 这种小团体自行车之旅是欣赏华盛顿特区世界闻名的樱花树及其美丽花朵的极佳方式。

ex.s: Para2:  We drove through several states and saw lots of great sights along the way.
ex.t: 第2段：我们开车经过几个州，看到沿途有许多伟大的景色。

ex.s: Place a few mirrors around your room so people can see how things look when they try them on.
ex.t: 在房间里放几面镜子，这样人们试穿时能看到效果。

ex.s: The end result is a read in which we learn to wonder like Socrates, see like Thoreau, listen like Schopenhauer, and have no regrets like Nietzsche.
ex.t: 最终读到的，是我们学会像苏格拉底一样发问、像梭罗一样观察、像叔本华一样倾听、像尼采一样无怨无悔。

ex.s: People have been bringing their children in to see the hens and residents come and sit outside to watch them.
ex.t: 人们带着孩子来看母鸡，居民们也出来坐在外面观看它们。

ex.s: Throughout our Junior year, my classmates and I have been worried about what colleges will see when they look at our whole life story reduced to a single 200-word essay.
ex.t: 整个高三那年，我和同学们一直担心，当大学招生官把我们整个生平浓缩成一篇200词的短文来审视时，他们会看到什么。

ex.s: Take a look online—evidence shows that thousands of teachers and parents know a good thing when they see it and recommend TOKNOW to their friends.
ex.t: 上网看看吧——有证据表明，成千上万的老师和家长都能辨识好东西，并向朋友推荐TOKNOW。

ex.s: When we look out of the window and see rain or snow, we can say “it’s raining” or “it’s snowing”.
ex.t: 当我们向窗外看去，看到下雨或下雪时，我们可以说"天在下雨"或"天在下雪"。

ex.s: “Let's look directly into the issue of collapse,” they say, “and deal with the terrible possibilities of what we see there to make the best of a troubling future.”
ex.t: “让我们直面崩溃这一问题，”他们说，“并应对我们在那里看到的那些可怕的可能性，以便在这令人不安的未来中做到最好。”

ex.s: It also gives people a chance to see what the new home looks like.
ex.t: 这也让人们有机会看看新家是什么样子。

ex.s: Next time you see a young person lost in thought, don’t rush to pull them back.
ex.t: 下次你看到一个陷入沉思的年轻人，不要急着把他们拉回来。

ex.s: Mike Curtin sees my arugula story all the time — but for him, it's more like 12 bones of donated strawberries nearing their last days.
ex.t: Mike Curtin总是看到我的芝麻菜故事——但对他来说，那更像12盒快过期的捐赠草莓。

ex.s: “I remember the first time I saw a humpback whale; it just rose out of the water like some prehistoric creature and I thought it was smiling at us.
ex.t: “我记得第一次看到座头鲸的时候，它就像某种史前生物一样从水中升起，我觉得它在对着我们微笑。

ex.s: The pressures of "time" and "destination" are further blocks to awareness． I encountered many hikers who were headed to a distant camp﹣ground with just enough time to get there before dark． It seldom occurred to them to wander a bit， to take a moment to see what's around them． I asked them what they'd seen． "Oh， a few birds， "they said． They seemed bent on their destinations．
ex.t: 时间和'目的地'的压力是觉悟的进一步障碍。我遇到许多徒步者，他们赶往一个遥远的营地，刚好有足够时间在天黑前到达。他们很少想到要闲逛一会儿，花点时间看看周围有什么。我问他们看到了什么。'哦，几只鸟，'他们说。他们似乎一心奔着目的地。

ex.s: My two sets of grandparents lived in Colorado and North Dakota, and my parents decided to spend a few weeks driving to those states and seeing all the sights along the way.
ex.t: 我的两对祖父母分别住在科罗拉多州和北达科他州，父母决定花几周时间开车去那些州，沿途看遍所有景点。

ex.s: It's a joy for him to see the kids get excited when they learn to sound out words.
ex.t: 最重要的是，故事具有变革的力量，让我们能够以一种不同于独自面对世界的方式来看待这个世界。

ex.s: Hospital patients Who see tree branches out their window are likely to recover at a faster rate than patients who see buildings or sky instead.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 从窗户能看到树枝的医院病人，康复速度可能比看建筑和天空的病人更快。

ex.s: They saw a man   36    out of a garbage can.
ex.t: 他们看到一个男人____36____从垃圾桶里出来。

ex.s: I drove over and saw the chick in the nest looking healthy and active.
ex.t: 我开车过去，看到巢里的小鸟看起来健康又活跃。

ex.s: One August afternoon, I sat in my kitchen staring at a glass vase that hadn’t seen daylight since my wedding.
ex.t: 八月的一个下午，我坐在厨房里，盯着一只自婚礼以来就没再见天日的玻璃花瓶。

ex.s: Even if you haven’t been to the small fishing village Mevagissey, you’ve probably seen it in a movie or British TV show.
ex.t: 即便你没去过Mevagissey这个小渔村，也可能在电影或英国电视剧里见过它。

ex.s: He loved biking around his neighbourhood but grew upset seeing that many plastic bottles littered the parks and sidewalks.
ex.t: 他喜欢在社区周围骑自行车，但看到许多塑料瓶散落在公园和人行道上，感到很沮丧。

ex.s: You see much more from the seat of a bike!
ex.t: 坐在自行车上你能看到更多的风景！

ex.s: The best table in this two-story colonial Thai home offers a window right into the kitchen, where you can see chef Gaggan and his staff in action.
ex.t: 这座两层殖民风格泰式宅邸里最好的桌子有一扇正对厨房的窗，你可以看到加甘主厨及其团队工作的情形。

ex.s: Ask the tourists from around the world that flood into Yellowstone National Park what they most hope to see, and their answer is often the same: a grizzly bear.
ex.t: 向来自世界各地的游客询问淹没进入黄石国家公园的游客最希望看到什么，他们的答案往往是一样的：一只灰熊。

ex.s: The wall is 12 meters high and from here you can see streams of people moving inside and outside the City Wall.
ex.t: 城墙高12米，从这里你可以看到川流不息的人群在城墙内外移动。

ex.s: It used to be that you  drive for miles here without seeing another person, but now there are houses and people everywhere.
ex.t: 过去在这里你可以开车数英里看不到一个人但现在到处都是房子和人。

ex.s: As I watched him take off his basketball uniform and replace it with a baseball uniform, I saw him leaving behind the layer that no longer served him, just as our lizard had.
ex.t: 当我看他脱下篮球服、换上棒球服时，我看到他丢下了那层不再适合他的外壳，就像我们的蜥蜴一样。

ex.s: “The important thing is that the technologist associates what is happening outside the patient's body with what the patient sees in his head," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: "重要的是技术员要将患者身体外发生的情况与患者脑海中看到的内容联系起来，"勒屈耶女士说。

ex.s: Now, I see my children taking their children to the library and I love that the excitement of going to the library lives on form generation to generation.
ex.t: 现在，我看到我的孩子们带着他们的孩子去图书馆，我很高兴去图书馆的兴奋之情一代代传承下去。

ex.s: When people see you trying to be funny, it frees them to try it themselves.
ex.t: 当人们看到你在努力变得有趣时，这让他们也敢于尝试。

ex.s: It’s not something you see every day.
ex.t: 这不是你每天都能看到的东西。

ex.s: When you see the capitalized “WHO” in a medical report, do you read it as the “who” in “Who’s that?
ex.t: 当你在医学报告中看到大写的＂WHO＂时，你是把它读作＂Who's that＂中的＂who＂吗？

ex.s: In the near future，it's not just going to be the number you see on your screen that will be in doubt.
ex.t: 在不久的将来，不仅仅是你在屏幕上看到的数字将受到质疑。

ex.s: In artists’ representations of books and reading, we see moments of shared humanity that go beyond culture and time.
ex.t: 在艺术家对书籍和阅读的描绘中，我们看到了超越文化与时代的、人类共有的瞬间。

ex.s: If you see a painting of a movement, like of a man pulling his arm away after being bitten by a dog, you feel like going through a similar experience.
ex.t: 如果你看到一幅描绘运动的画作，比如一个人被狗咬后缩回手臂的画面，你会感觉自己仿佛经历了类似的体验。

ex.s: “From seeing the wildlife to witnessing sunrises, the whole experience was amazing.
ex.t: "从观赏野生动物到见证日出，整个经历令人惊叹。

ex.s: When I let them see an aspect of my life outside of school, some students who were also interested in cars connected with me more and became more engaged in my courses.
ex.t: 当我让他们看到我校外生活的一面时，一些同样对汽车感兴趣的学生与我更有共鸣，也更投入我的课程。

ex.s: The man froze for a second, but when he saw the skinny boy he breathed a sigh of relief.
ex.t: 那名男子愣了一下，但当他看到那个瘦小的男孩时，松了一口气。

ex.s: My heart raced when I saw the email sender’s name.
ex.t: 当我看到邮件发件人的名字时，我的心跳加速了。

ex.s: What was Bob doing when Alex saw him?
ex.t: Alex看到Bob时，Bob在做什么？

ex.s: What was Bob doing when Alex saw him?
ex.t: Alex看到Bob时，Bob在做什么？

ex.s: And when he saw the mists rising from the river and the soft clouds.
ex.t: 当他看到从河上升起的雾气和柔软的云朵时。

ex.s: Poppy welcomed them home as usual but when she saw the box, she stopped.
ex.t: Poppy像往常一样欢迎他们回家，但当她看到盒子时，她停下来了。

ex.s: “I especially liked the reactions of the parents and the patients when they saw his artwork.
ex.t: 嘿那挺酷的，'"Parry回忆道。

ex.s: （1分）It was only when the car pulled up in front of our house               we saw Lily in the passenger seat．（  ）
ex.t: 14．（1分）只有当汽车停在我们家门前时，____我们才看到副驾驶座上的莉莉。（  ）

ex.s: When I arrived, I saw a 2-to 3-week-old owl.
ex.t: 到达时，我看到一只2到3周大的猫头鹰。

ex.s: They didn’t think much of it when they saw two cyclists repairing their bike on the side of the road.
ex.t: 他们看到路边有两个骑自行车的人在修车时并没有太在意。

ex.s: Norphel’s inspiration came from seeing the waste of water over winter, when it was not needed.
ex.t: 诺普尔的灵感来自于看到冬季水的浪费，那时水并不需要。

ex.s: Days later when the curtain was drawn, I saw this  31  old man for the first time.
ex.t: 几天后当帘子拉开时，我第一次看到了这位31 老人。

ex.s: But when we see sunshine, we can’t say “it’s sunshining”.
ex.t: 但当我们看到阳光时，我们不能说“阳光在照耀”。

ex.s: Today, people still come and go — to see where the Canadian gold rush happened.
ex.t: 如今，人们仍然来来往往——来看看加拿大淘金热发生的地方。

ex.s: Mum voiced what we were all thinking: It was strange to see the place so empty.
ex.t: 妈妈说出了我们所有人的想法：看到这个地方如此空荡荡，感觉很奇怪。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: “I could see them actually walking under the sea."
ex.t: “我能看到它们其实在海底行走。”

ex.s: We see scenes of children learning to read at home or at school, with the book as a focus for relations between the generations.
ex.t: 我们看到了孩子们在家或在学校学习阅读的场景，书成为代际关系的焦点。

ex.s: Mr Bissell skillfully organizes historical insights and cultural references, making his tale a well-rounded picture of Uzbekistan, seen from Western eyes.
ex.t: 比斯尔先生巧妙地编排历史洞见与文化指涉，使他的故事成为一幅从西方视角看去的、完整的乌兹别克斯坦图景。

ex.s: They asked to see the Grandma's Box.
ex.t: 他们要求看看"奶奶的盒子"。

ex.s: If your child sees you enjoying your work and taking pride in a job well done, they’re far more likely to do the same.
ex.t: 如果你的孩子看到你享受工作并为把事情做好感到自豪，他们也更有可能这样做。

ex.s: Scholars have seen this idea in practice with ancient Greek and Roman statues.
ex.t: 如果我们不看到艺术品最初的样子，就无法欣赏这些细节——史密斯认为只有当你有一份指南时才能做到这一点。

ex.s: We can't appreciate these kinds of details without seeing works of art as they originally appeared-something Smith believes you can do only when you have a road map.
ex.t: 如果不把这些艺术品按最初的样子来看，我们就无法欣赏此类细节——史密斯认为，只有当你有一张“路线图”时才能做到这一点。

ex.s: If we see the elderly trying to catch their planes but walking at a snail’s pace, we find a wheelchair for them immediately.
ex.t: 如果我们看到老人试图赶飞机却以蜗牛般的速度行走，我们会立刻为他们找来轮椅。

ex.s: If you think you can do without the fence because you’ve never seen a fox, consider if the existence of the fence is precisely why you’ve never seen one.

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。
